mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.admin.mapper.AdminMapper.selectPpsHistoryListForAdmin */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.proposal_no DESC) AS rnum , p.proposal_no , vm.user_email , CONCAT(vm.user_nm,' (',vd.company_nm, ')') as user_nm , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.proposal_title) > 30 THEN LEFT(p.proposal_title, 30) || '...' ELSE p.proposal_title END AS proposal_title , IFNULL(comState.code_nm, '회원등록') AS step_vendor , CASE WHEN p.send_d IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(p.reg_dt, '%y.%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.send_d, '%y.%m.%d') END AS send_d , IFNULL(comLast.code_nm, '') AS assess_result , p.last_result , p.state_lrtp , p.state_rtp FROM seinfo_proposal p JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager vm ON p.user_uid = vm.user_uid JOIN seinfo_vendor vd ON vm.company_no = vd.company_no JOIN (SELECT gr.proposal_no AS gr_no, CASE WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '35' THEN '35' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '40' THEN '40' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '30' THEN '30' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp != '30' THEN '20' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '50' AND gr.add_no_cnt > 0 THEN '75' ELSE gr.state_lrtp END AS gr_state FROM (SELECT lps.proposal_no, MAX(lps.state_lrtp) AS state_lrtp, MAX(lps.state_rtp) AS state_rtp, COUNT(lrc.request_seq) AS add_no_cnt FROM seinfo_proposal lps LEFT JOIN seinfo_request_cont lrc ON lrc.proposal_no = lps.proposal_no AND lrc.request_yn = 'A' AND lrc.answer_yn = 'R' AND lrc.approval_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont aw WHERE aw.proposal_no = lrc.proposal_no AND aw.request_yn = lrc.request_yn AND aw.request_seq = lrc.request_seq AND aw.answer_yn = 'A') GROUP BY lps.proposal_no) gr) lps ON lps.gr_no = p.proposal_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'RTPC004') comLast ON comLast.code_value = ( CASE WHEN p.state_lrtp = '90' AND p.assess_skip_yn = 'Y' THEN 'R' ELSE p.last_result END ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'RTPC010') comState ON comState.code_value = lps.gr_state WHERE IFNULL(vm.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND vm.bl_yn = 'N' AND p.state_lrtp NOT IN ('01') AND p.state_rtp NOT IN('35') ORDER BY p.proposal_no DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startRow}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.admin.mapper.AdminMapper.getPpsHistoryListCountForAdmin */ COUNT(*) FROM seinfo_proposal p INNER JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager a ON a.user_uid = p.user_uid WHERE IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.bl_yn = 'N' AND p.state_lrtp NOT IN ('01') AND p.state_rtp NOT IN('35')

b.user_email , b.user_phone , (SELECT code_nm || IF(a.proposal_area ='99', ' : '||a.proposal_area_cont, '') AS code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id ='RTPC001' AND code_value = a.proposal_area ) AS proposal_area_nm , a.chief_manager , IFNULL(comState.code_nm, '회원등록') AS step_vender /* 진행단계 */ , CASE WHEN a.send_d IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.reg_dt, '%y.%m.%d') WHEN rc.request_yn = 'M' AND rc.answer_yn = 'A' AND a.state_rtp = '40' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS mod_request_yn FROM seinfo_proposal a JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager b ON a.user_uid = b.user_uid JOIN seinfo_vendor c ON b.company_no = c.company_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT proposal_no, request_yn, answer_yn, request_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY proposal_no ORDER BY request_seq DESC) AS rn FROM seinfo_request_cont ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) rc ON rc.proposal_no = a.proposal_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT gr.proposal_no AS gr_no, CASE WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '35' THEN '35' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '40' THEN '40' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '30' THEN '30' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp != '30' THEN '20' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '50' AND gr.add_no_cnt > 0 THEN '75' ELSE gr.state_lrtp END AS gr_state FROM (SELECT lps.proposal_no, MAX(lps.state_lrtp) AS state_lrtp, MAX(lps.state_rtp) AS state_rtp, COUNT(lrc.request_seq) AS add_no_cnt FROM seinfo_proposal lps LEFT JOIN seinfo_request_cont lrc ON lrc.proposal_no = lps.proposal_no AND lrc.request_yn = 'A' AND lrc.answer_yn = 'R' AND lrc.approval_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont aw WHERE aw.proposal_no = lrc.proposal_no AND aw.request_yn = lrc.request_yn AND aw.request_seq = lrc.request_seq AND aw.answer_yn = 'A') GROUP BY lps.proposal_no) gr) lps ON lps.gr_no = a.proposal_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'RTPC004') comLast ON comLast.code_value = ( CASE WHEN a.state_lrtp = '90' AND a.assess_skip_yn = 'Y' THEN 'R' ELSE a.last_result END ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'RTPC010') comState ON comState.code_value = lps.gr_state WHERE a.proposal_no = #{proposalNo} AND IFNULL(b.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' AND b.bl_yn = 'N'
